changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'MapItemMap') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[MapItemMap]( [MapID] [int] NOT NULL, [MapItemID] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MapItemMap] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [MapID] ASC, [MapItemID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MapItemMap_Map') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[MapItemMap] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MapItemMap_Map] FOREIGN KEY([MapID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Map] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[MapItemMap] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MapItemMap_Map] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MapItemMap_MapItem') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[MapItemMap] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MapItemMap_MapItem] FOREIGN KEY([MapItemID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[MapItem] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[MapItemMap] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MapItemMap_MapItem] END
